findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There were a handful of gnats observed in the dry storage area where soda boxes are stored. The facility has a glow LED light trap for insect control. Discussed purchasing insect glue traps to hang from ceiling in non food prep areas. Ensure that the premise is maintained free of insects.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The hood baffles above the fryer station were observed accumulated with grease debris. PIC mentioned that Steam Power services the hood system and that the company is behind on cleaning services. Discussed that baffles can be manually cleaned by staff in between professional cleanings. Ensure that baffles are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Overall, the facility is need of a deep cleaning in the following areas:
- Floors throughout the kitchen (underneath and behind equipment)
- Outer surfaces of equipment
- Walls and ceilings throughout the entire facility
When time permits, be sure to clean physical facilities at a frequency to prevent buildup of grease and food debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The ceiling tile, close to the food prep station area for prepping chicken, was observed with mold buildup. Shown to the PIC and the tile was cleaned to correct the violation. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent mold accumulation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer bucket along the cook-line tested below 100ppm (quat). The sani solution was changed and retested at 200ppm to correct the violation. Ensure that sanitizer solutions are testing at the manufacturer's recommendation to be sure that food contact surfaces are getting properly sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(C)(4) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations, including the application of SANITIZING chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods, using a solution as specified under § 4-501.114. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA registered label use instructions by providing: (4) A contact time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and PH that, when evaluated for efficacy, yields SANITIZATION as defined in 1-201.10(B).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the inside surfaces of the microwave (across from the fryers) to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC and surfaces were cleaned by an employee. Ensure that the inside surfaces of the microwave are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent soil accumulation and contamination of food. 

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed mop head stored in bucket with waste water. Discussed with PIC and mop was repositioned in a manner to air dry. Ensure mops are stored in a position that allows for them to air dry properly. Never store in waste water. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a broken tile piece on the outside of the mop basin. There was water trapped underneath the broken floor tile. PIC stated that the floor tiles are in the process of being replaced. Ensure that floor tiles are repaired and maintained in a manner that the prevents water or debris from seeping through. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Overall, the facility is in need of a deep cleaning in the following areas: 

- Floors throughout kitchen and cook-line
- Floors and walls in mop area
- Outside surfaces and underneath equipment 
- Legs and sides of equipment

The areas were accumulated with grease and food debris. Ensure that areas are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent accumulation.
